threshold_policy: The validation-tuned threshold is reported as a sensitivity experiment. The operational dashboard keeps the pre-specified 0.50 threshold so that a threshold that fails to generalize is not silently deployed.

multiclass_experiment.task: conditional attack-family classification on attack rows only
